description_en: Queries image resources that are available to you
description_zh: 查询您可以使用的镜像资源
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone list-images --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id cpm-xxxxxxxx --image-name testImageName --image-category system --instance-type ecp.ce.large --status Available --next-token ADBAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImages

parameters.help_en: The image IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the image. Valid values:
system: a public image provided by Alibaba Cloud.
self: a custom image that you created.
others: an image shared to you by another Alibaba Cloud user
parameters.help_zh:
镜像来源。取值范围：
system：阿里云提供的公共镜像。
self：您创建的自定义镜像。
others：其他阿里云用户共享给您的镜像
parameters.name: image_category

parameters.help_en:
The status of the image to query. Valid values:
Waiting: The image is waiting in the task queue.
Creating: The image is being created.
Copying: The image is being copied.
Importing: The image is being imported.
Available (default): The image is available for use.
CreateFailed: The image failed to be created
parameters.help_zh:
查询某种状态下的镜像。取值范围：
Waiting：多任务排队中。
Creating：镜像正在创建中。
Copying：镜像正在复制中。
Importing：镜像正在导入中。
Available（默认）：您可以使用的镜像。
CreateFailed：创建失败的镜像
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用无需配置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回的最大数，取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the image was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard
CreationTime.description_zh: 镜像创建时间，采用ISO 8601格式

IsSelfShared.description_en: Indicates whether the image has been shared to other users
IsSelfShared.description_zh: 该镜像是否已共享给其他用户

OSName.description_en: The display name of the operating system in Chinese
OSName.description_zh: 操作系统的中文显示名称

OSNameEn.description_en: The display name of the operating system in English
OSNameEn.description_zh: 操作系统的英文显示名称

OSType.description_en: The type of the operating system

Usage.description_en:
Indicates whether the image is running on a cloud phone instance. Valid values:
none: The image is idle and not used by any cloud phone instance.
instance: The image is in use by a cloud phone instance
Usage.description_zh:
镜像是否已经运行在云手机实例中。取值范围：
none：镜像处于闲置状态，暂无云手机实例使用。
instance：镜像处于运行状态，有云手机实例使用

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
MaxResults.description_zh: 返回的最大数，取值范围：1~100

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page
NextToken.description_zh: 返回下一页的查询凭证
